create_HiCacheNixl_backend: create a HiCacheNixl storage backend with NIXL agent for high-performance KV cache transfer
register_buffers_with_nixl: register torch tensor buffers with NIXL for zero-copy memory transfers
batch_get_v1_from_storage: batch get KV cache pages from NIXL storage into host memory using zero-copy or non-zero-copy mode
batch_set_v1_to_storage: batch set KV cache pages from host memory to NIXL storage with file or object backend
batch_exists_in_storage: check which keys exist in NIXL storage and return count of present keys
